title.rendered: YEE Aquarium Sponge Filter with Bio Media

content.rendered:
The YEE Aquarium Sponge Filter with Bio Media provides efficient mechanical and biological filtration for freshwater aquariums. Its multi-layer sponge structure traps debris while protecting fry and shrimp from suction.
The integrated bio-media chamber supports beneficial bacteria growth, helping stabilize water quality and reduce ammonia and nitrite levels. Designed for quiet operation and easy maintenance, this sponge filter is ideal for breeding tanks, shrimp tanks, betta tanks, and small community aquariums.

Reliable Filtration for Healthy Aquariums

The YEE Aquarium Sponge Filter with Bio Media offers safe and stable filtration for freshwater aquariums.

It works especially well in fry tanks, shrimp tanks, and breeding setups. This filter combines mechanical and biological

filtration in one compact design. It helps keep water clean while supporting a balanced aquarium environment.

Gentle Mechanical Filtration

The multi-layer sponge captures fish waste, leftover food, and fine debris. At the same time, it keeps water

flow gentle and safe. Small fish, shrimp, and fry can swim freely without risk. Unlike strong power filters,

this sponge filter does not create harmful suction. This makes it ideal for delicate aquatic life.

The sponge surface also provides a large area for beneficial bacteria.

These bacteria help break down waste naturally and improve water quality over time.

Built-In Bio Media for Biological Balance

Inside the filter, a dedicated bio-media chamber supports nitrifying bacteria growth.

These bacteria convert ammonia and nitrite into less harmful nitrate. As a result,

water parameters stay more stable and fish experience less stress.

This biological support makes the filter suitable for long-term use. It is not just a temporary solution.

Many aquarists use it as a main filter in small tanks or as extra biological support in larger systems.

Part of the YEE Aquarium Filter Collection

This product belongs to the YEE Aquarium Filter collection. It works well alongside other filtration systems.

Ideal for Breeding and Community Tanks

Whether you keep shrimp, raise fry, or maintain a small community aquarium, this sponge filter delivers steady performance.

It provides gentle water flow, reliable filtration, and long-lasting durability.

The YEE Aquarium Sponge Filter is a practical choice for aquarists who value safety, stability, and ease of use.

title.rendered: Premium High‑Fiber Rabbit Food — Healthy Pellets for Adult & Young Rabbits

content.rendered:
🥕 Why High‑Fiber Rabbit Food Matters

Rabbits are hindgut fermenters, which means their diet must be very high in fiber for proper digestion. A good rabbit food formula provides 20–30% crude fiber and balanced protein to support gut health and dental wear.

Many rabbit owners search for “high fiber rabbit pellets” or “rabbit food with probiotics” when they want to avoid digestive issues. Using the right formula helps reduce GI stasis and ensures longer, healthier life for your bunny.

🌿 Key Features & Nutritional Highlights

  • High fiber content (e.g. 24% crude fiber) to support digestive function

  • Moderate protein (not excessive) to maintain lean body condition

  • Added vitamins & minerals for overall health

  • Optional formulations with probiotics / organic ingredients

  • Pellet form helps prevent selective feeding

Our rabbit food pellets are designed to be a staple diet. Pair with unlimited hay (grass or timothy) and fresh water.

🐇 Feeding Guidelines & Tips

  • Feed 50–70 g of pellets per kg of body weight daily

  • Divide the daily allowance into multiple meals

  • Store in cool, dry place, reseal packaging after opening

  • Monitor your rabbit’s droppings — ideal droppings are firm round pellets
